prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1300; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas, near a shopping center. I was in the right lane heading toward the interchange.
Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was changing lanes to the left because I needed to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror and saw nothing close, so I signaled and started moving over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until it was almost beside me. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car pull toward the right. The other car had come up in the lane I was moving into.
Q: Did you apply your brakes or swerve?
A: I braked a little and steered back the other way, but the contact had already happened. My car spun slightly and ended up against the curb.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my left arm out on the steering wheel and landed hard on my wrist when the airbag deployed. I was taken to the hospital by ambulance.
Q: What was the diagnosis?
A: The doctors said I fractured my wrist. I've been told I'll need a cast and possibly follow-up care with a hand specialist.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I was driving carefully and I'm willing to provide photos of my vehicle and my medical records to help with the claim.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
